method: Four simultaneous cold-corpus queries; only original sites and discovered links. No model, no background crawler, no provider. Rust book URL is a known entry listing, not a known answer URL. Cache phase explicitly disables discovery and reads. This measures bounded discovery, not global search recall or model answer quality.

warnings: Results cover only this installation's bounded public index. Missing results do not establish absence on the internet. Source reads and crawling contact original public pages; no external search provider is used.

Live discovery is bounded to selected entry pages and at most 6 relevant observed links (2 per origin); it is not full platform or internet search. Inspect discovery.sources for blocked, timed-out or unread sources. Use relevant domains or known source_urls to focus coverage.

Identical indexed content is deduplicated. At most 2 results per requested domain (including subdomains), or normalized hostname when no domain filter matches. This diversity cap can return fewer than 5 results.
No matching indexed pages satisfy these filters yet. Read known source URLs or allow the background crawler to build coverage; do not invent results or repeatedly poll.
